LanguageData.LP_Demigod.label: demigod
LanguageData.LP_Demigod.description: A divine spark burns in a mortal body. Ageless, hunger ×0.3, immune to disease, psychic sensitivity +20% (+5% more per rank), damage taken ×0.95 (×0.95 more per rank), mental break threshold -10%; the portfolio grants two active abilities and one passive. Divine power recovers daily; when it is full you may accept the trials of the gods to raise your divine rank.
LanguageData.LP_UnfadingDawn.label: undying dawn
LanguageData.LP_UnfadingDawn.description: Lathander's morning light protects this person: the first lethal wound will not kill, and wounds stop bleeding at once.
LanguageData.LP_JusticeShield.label: shield of justice
LanguageData.LP_DivineDominated.label: dominated
LanguageData.LP_DivineDominated.description: Mind dominated by a demigod. Will return to the original faction when it ends.
LanguageData.LP_CallWindHaste.label: call the wind
LanguageData.LP_ForgeBlessing.label: forge blessing
LanguageData.LP_ForgeBlessing.description: Surtur's fire burns on the weapon: melee hits add 6 burn damage.
LanguageData.LP_PredatorForm.label: predator form
LanguageData.LP_OblivionFog.label: mist of forgetting
LanguageData.LP_OblivionFog.description: Everything is clouded in mist; often forgets what to aim at: shooting accuracy ×0.6.
LanguageData.LP_SummonedTemp.label: divine summons
LanguageData.LP_SummonedTemp.description: Summoned by a demigod; will leave or crumble when time is up.
LanguageData.LP_FreezeRevivalAura.label: frozen revival
LanguageData.LP_FreezeRevivalAura.description: Judicator of Kelemvor: within 15 cells, the revival timers of liches and trolls are paused.
LanguageData.LP_GiantKing.label: giant king
LanguageData.LP_GiantKing.description: A giant king who came to answer the titan's challenge.
